summary: A labelled diagram of the app shell showing a 52px rail, a 200px panel and the main content area.
use: Explaining how the app shell is divided before wiring navigation into it.
spec: Root is `role="img"` with `aria-label="App shell anatomy: rail, panel and main content"`

Rail label `Rail
52px` over 4 icon blocks, the second marked `class:rail-icon--active={i === 1}`

Panel label `Panel
200px` over items Dashboard, Users, Reports, Settings, the first marked `class:panel-item--active={i === 0}`
Main area labelled Main content with a top bar and 3 content blocks, one `content-block--short`
